message: Hi, my kid Sam is 10 and wants to try jiu jitsu. Do you have classes for that age?
Hey! Yes, we do! We have Kids BJJ classes that run Monday through Thursday for ages 4-13. Sam would be a great fit. Is this something you'd like to get him started with a free trial?
Yes, I'd love to get him started with a free trial! What time do the classes run?
Perfect! For new students, Kids BJJ runs Monday through Thursday from 5:00pm to 5:30pm. Sam can start with any of those days. Would you like to get him booked for a trial class?
Yes, let's book him for a trial class on Monday at 5:00pm.
Perfect! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Great, thanks Tester! And what's the best email to send the trial confirmation to?
Perfect! And is this the best number to reach you at if we need to?
Got it! Last thing I need is Sam's full name and date of birth to get him registered for the trial.
Perfect! Sam is all set for his free trial class today, Monday at 5:00pm. We're located at 4808 E Sprague Ave suite 205. Just have him wear comfortable athletic clothes. See you soon!
